title: Airline Routes
source: Japanese network: [酒井正子「変容する世界の航空界・その4 日本の航空100年」](https://appsv.main.teikyo-u.ac.jp/tosho/keizaigaku44-1-09.pdf) and [昭和五年四月改正 定期航空発着時刻及賃金表 (1930)](https://www.timetableimages.com/ttimages/jat3004.htm). Occupied China: [中華航空株式會社 時刻表 (1940)](https://www.timetableimages.com/ttimages/ckkk/ckkk40c/ckkk3.jpg). Dutch East Indies: [KLM Amsterdam–Batavia summer service (1938)](https://northwestairlineshistory.org/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/KLM-schedule-1938-03-29-AMS-JKT-route.pdf) and the [K.N.I.L.M. route map (c. 1935)](https://www.davidrumsey.com/luna/servlet/detail/RUMSEY~8~1~356322~90123241:Complete-Map-of-the-Airlines-of-K-N).

title: Taiwan Railways
source: [日治時期鐵路分布圖](https://data.depositar.io/dataset/rd15-07030) (Academia Sinica), reprojected to TWD97, with several stretches traced from the 1944 American 1:25,000 sheet.

title: Korea Railways
source: [근대 철도 DB](https://www.hisgeo.info/wiki/%EA%B7%BC%EB%8C%80_%EC%B2%A0%EB%8F%84_DB) by 김종혁, filtered by the year each line opened.

title: Karafuto Railways
source: Traced for this map from 最新樺太地圖 and the 樺太路線図 at [時刻表倉庫](https://jikokusouko.pages.dev/index.htm), checked against the 1947 U.S. Army sheets.

title: Japan Railways
source: The Japanese lines for 1930 and 1942 are filtered from the dataset provided by the [国土交通省国土数値情報ダウンロードサイト](https://nlftp.mlit.go.jp/ksj/gml/datalist/KsjTmplt-N05-v1_3.html). The source’s survey begins in 1950, so railways that closed before 1950 are likely to be missing from the data.

title: Japan Stations
source: The Japanese lines for 1930 and 1942 are filtered from the dataset provided by the [国土交通省国土数値情報ダウンロードサイト](https://nlftp.mlit.go.jp/ksj/gml/datalist/KsjTmplt-N05-v1_3.html). The source’s survey begins in 1950, so railways that closed before 1950 are likely to be missing from the data.
